records.name: Native secp256k1 base-field arithmetic
records.summary: Balanced-radix secp256k1 multiplication and squaring with ordinary-domain and factor-16 Montgomery-domain normalized-Karatsuba profiles and exact witness-carried integer reduction.
records.security: Operands passed to compact gates must be verified-path outputs of the native field certificate or an earlier gate. The ordinary profile uses eleven quotient coefficients and 56 carries; factor-16 uses one residual and 28 carries. Script derives and certifies the remainder while checking one exact integer relation, so no CRT-wraparound assumption is used. Circuit authors must preserve the factor-16 E(x)=x/16 semantic domain.
records.stack_contract: A field value is 29 balanced radix-512 digits with digit zero nearest the top. Ordinary multiplication consumes certified lhs[28..0] | rhs[28..0] | q[10..0] | carries[55..0]; factor-16 consumes encoded lhs[28..0] | rhs[28..0] | t | carries[27..0]. Each returns certified r[28..0] in its own domain. Preserved-item arguments count unrelated main and altstack state.

records.name: Prime residue-number arithmetic
records.summary: Prime RNS profiles for exact unsigned 256-by-256-bit products, coordinate-major table-amortized batches, and fixed-modulus witness-hinted reduction, including compact conditional, standalone globally bound, and reusable-certificate composable verifiers.
records.security: Each combined modulus is composite, so exact-integer semantics require a proved expression bound. The coordinate-only hinted profiles, including the 42-prime carry verifier, are conditional on external global bindings for every supplied vector. The standalone 47-prime secp256k1-target profile range-checks four shared 16-limb values and closes all bindings locally. The 46-prime composable profile instead inherits certified lhs/rhs vectors from its own field-value binder or a prior multiplication, binds hostile q and r locally, and returns a certified r vector; passing raw witness residue vectors violates its soundness precondition. In both globally safe profiles, the product basis exceeds 2^512 and all exact ScriptNum prefixes are checked.
records.stack_contract: The no-carry profile uses 75 canonical residues and contiguous vectors. Its batch API consumes coordinate-major operand pairs and leaves coordinate-major products on the altstack. The conditional carry profile consumes 42 coordinate-interleaved groups lhs_i | rhs_i | q_i | r_i | [complement_i] | carry_i and returns 42 remainder residues. The standalone profile consumes 64 centered limbs followed by 47 five-carry groups and returns 16 centered remainder limbs beneath 47 canonical remainder residues. The composable gate consumes certified lhs[46] | rhs[46] | q_limbs[16] | r_limbs[16] | 46 reverse-coordinate three-carry groups and returns only certified r[46]; its preserved-item argument counts unrelated main and alt stack state.

records.name: Instance-specialized secp256k1 Schnorr verification
records.summary: BIP340 fixed-instance verification using a GLV/wNAF/Jacobian public generator and exact bigint9 field certificates for the final affine equation.
records.security: BIP340 range and even-y lift rules are enforced by the deterministic generator. Script binds all hostile arithmetic operands to the fixed instance and checks exact quotient/carry reductions. Correctness additionally trusts the generator's public tagged hash and scalar multiplications; this is not a spend-time signature verifier.
records.stack_contract: Witness is G1 | G0 | S: two 125-item raw multiplication groups followed by one 96-item raw square group. The square is consumed first, then the two-product batch; success consumes all 346 items and leaves one truthy item at a strict 882-item peak.

configurations.label: Fixed BIP340 instance with GLV/wNAF/Jacobian generator and 2M/1S field proof
configurations.includes: complete-leaf: fixed-instance BIP340 operand binding, raw canonical operand certification, exact hinted reduction for one specialized square and two shared-table multiplications, all three output comparisons, complete arithmetic-witness consumption, and a clean terminal truthy result; excludes public tagged-hash and GLV/wNAF/Jacobian scalar-multiplication generator work, tapleaf/control-block serialization, complete transaction context, and Bitcoin Core validation; witness bytes are for the deterministic key [3;32], message [42;32], and no-aux libsecp256k1 signature

limitations: The key, message, and signature are fixed before script generation; spend-time signature selection is not supported
Public tagged hashing and scalar multiplication are trusted generator computations rather than Script constraints
The measured script is unoptimized because it exceeds the repository's 32-KiB optimizer cutoff
Bitcoin Core consensus and relay-policy validation have not been performed
Legacy and P2WSH script-size/opcode limits are exceeded
Rare affine exceptional cases compile to a fixed outcome instead of the common three-relation field proof

records.name: Explicit witness-driven secp256k1 Schnorr verification
records.summary: BIP340 check-signature-from-stack research verifier with witness-selected message/signature, Script-computed challenge, and hinted affine double-scalar multiplication.
records.security: The public key is fixed by the script. Hostile witness inputs supply the message, r, s, even nonce y-coordinate, and arithmetic hints. Script computes the tagged challenge, validates s<n and the nonce lift/parity, and checks exact field relations for sG-eP=R. The relaxed local executor disables the consensus stack limit.
records.stack_contract: Arithmetic hints precede R.y | r | s | message. The deterministic configuration has 32,556 serialized witness items and peaks at 33,589 combined stack items under relaxed execution, so it is known to exceed Bitcoin's 1,000-item limit.

configurations.label: Witness-driven BIP340 verifier with signed width-8 position tables
configurations.includes: complete-leaf: public-key-specialized BIP340 challenge hashing, hostile r/s/message parsing, supplied R.y field/curve/evenness validation, signed-window recoding, fixed-base table selection, complete hinted affine transitions, final point equality, and clean terminal true; excludes tapleaf/control-block serialization, complete transaction context, and Bitcoin Core validation; witness bytes use key [3;32], message [42;32], and the no-aux libsecp256k1 signature

The revealed script cannot fit within Bitcoin transaction/block weight limits

records.name: Fast base-16 Winternitz signatures
records.summary: Tapscript-specialized HASH160 Winternitz with canonical-bit size profiles, mixed-radix checksums, strict-chain and exact-hash alternatives, and consuming keys.
records.security: Strictly one-time classic HASH160-chain Winternitz, not WOTS+; durable seed-reuse prevention remains a caller obligation. Bitwise profiles bind canonical false/true items through tapscript MINIMALIF; numeric profiles do not bind raw in-range ScriptNum serialization. Size profiles accept arbitrary-length HASH160 preimages whenever at least one hash executes, while signer nodes and strict profiles require 20 bytes.
records.stack_contract: Numeric witnesses contain 134 items; bitwise witnesses contain 333 items and peak at 334. Recovery profiles return 64 message nibbles, while terminal profiles clear all signature state and require a terminal predicate.

No Bitcoin Core consensus or policy reproduction

records.security: Canonical field range and every hinted equation must be checked; field arithmetic alone has no protocol security claim.
